acceptanceCriteria: Release artifacts pass install, upgrade, downgrade or rollback, uninstall, backup and corrupted-state recovery on supported platforms.
Hostile repositories, paths, symlinks, case folds, bounded output, memory, time, interruption cleanup and secret screening have release-blocking regressions.
A vulnerability-reporting policy, support window, changelog and reproducible release runbook are published.
body: Close stable operational and security expectations for the native Core without adding a service or permanent daemon.
title: Qualify stable operations, recovery and security
